preserved: Every original authorization stage and per-tool check

Exact original message, record, permission, approval, Run and budget bindings

failureCases: Missing, reordered or duplicate batch items and RPC failures reject without individual fallback
Wrong owner, datatype, UID, trailing BCS or mutable message source rejects
Permission, approval, approver grant, role, workspace, Run, claim, message and record version changes reject at final read
Prefetch derives fields from verified datatype origins
Repeated prefetch cannot replace the initial object version
Successful previous calls cannot satisfy current revocation or unavailable-RPC checks
Optional workspace absence retains its original meaning
